spec.name: Trend v33
spec.notes: Built for calm markets: the signal works in calm regimes and gives back part of it in stressed ones. Intended to run at reduced size when volatility is high.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 2.3, annual return 10%, maximum drawdown 14%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy relies on a simple momentum signal with minimal parameter tuning, yet the research log indicates a 'best-of' selection process across multiple trials. This introduces selection bias, inflating the reported Sharpe ratio. Furthermore, while the notes claim the strategy is intended to run at reduced size during volatility, the provided specification lacks any automated risk-management logic or volatility-scaling mechanism to execute this. The performance metrics are likely overfitted to the specific historical period tested. Given the lack of robust out-of-sample validation and the absence of dynamic risk controls, the strategy must be paper-traded to verify if the performance holds under real-time market conditions before any capital is deployed.
